answer: Sybil resistance here is a consumable assay gate: before an identity can earn, a lab must sign the spectrum hash of a ferrous inclusion locked in shale cut from one named ridge, and the agent binds that unused serial to its key. A farm of one thousand heads must purchase, courier, and assay one thousand different chips — about forty dollars and two days apiece, so roughly forty thousand dollars and a week — instead of looping a register call.
